problems: The blind guess was a fish, which is wrong. Only the second alternative (a bird with spread wings) fits, so the figure does not read as the intended gull on first sight.

Orientation is correct: head at top, wings spread horizontally, tail pointing down. The gold lines run head (2081/2072) to neck (2472) to body (3405), then out to the wings (5348, 7588, 118234) and down to the tail (2484, then 1599, 118121, 118322).
Beak is too short: star 2072 (tip of beak, about x=322, y=130) sits almost on top of crown star 2081 (about x=324, y=108), so the head reads as a dot with no beak.
Neck is a long thin line (2472 at about x=302, y=209) and the whole figure reads more like a heron or crane than a gull.

The wings are straight gold spokes (elbow 5348 at about x=216, y=306; wingtips 7588 at about x=158, y=343 and 118234 at about x=372, y=278) with no feathered wing silhouette, so the shape is a stick figure.
The blue outline is a loose, wobbly trace that roughly follows the gold lines rather than a clean bird silhouette, so it reads as a copy of the gold lines.

Labels collide: 'left wingtip' is crossed by a line, and 'left tail feather tip' (1599 at about x=304, y=455) and 'right tail feather tip' (118121 at about x=342, y=453) overlap each other near the tail.
Two unlabelled stars at about (214,176) and (279,166) sit in the open sky and may read as stray marks.
output.advice: Redraw as a clean, filled bird silhouette in flight, head up, wings spread, seen from the front or below, with a short neck and a broad body. Place the stars as follows: crown 2081 at about (324,108) on top of the head; beak tip 2072 about 14–18px further out, e.g. (326,122), so the beak is visible as a separate point; neck 2472 at about (302,209); body/heart 3405 at about (269,338) in the centre of the chest; elbow 5348 at about (216,306) on the leading edge of the left wing; left wingtip 7588 at about (158,343); right wingtip 118234 at about (372,278); tail base 2484 at about (287,424); tail tips 1599 at about (304,455), 118121 at about (342,453), and 118322 at about (335,470) fanning out below the base. Fill the wings and body as a solid shape with a feathered trailing edge between the elbow and tips, instead of straight spokes. Make the blue trace a single smooth outline of that silhouette, not a loose copy of the gold lines. Move the 'left wingtip' and tail-tip labels so they do not collide with lines or each other, and drop or move the two stray sky stars at (214,176) and (279,166) so they do not read as part of the figure."]
